messages:
asha: Quick FYI — Benchmark Labs just published a latency comparison: https://benchmarklabs.example/report. They call out Redwood hosted API with ~2x lower p95 at 512 tokens vs competitorX. Need coordinated comms: social, short blog note, PR outreach. Thoughts?
emily_pr: :eyes: nice. Can we get a 1-2 sentence quote from Jared? Also legal check on competitor callouts. I'll draft social + press note.
pressbot: Automated: Published Benchmark Labs article detected — https://benchmarklabs.example/report. Summary: mentions Redwood lowest median p95 latency at 512 tokens.
tom_ops: I'll confirm the test conditions with infra. If numbers hold, ops wants to add a microbenchmark blurb to Console's release notes.
raj_growth: I can queue amplification across channels. Do we want the benchmark graph screenshot for high engagement? Need hi-res.
asha: Action items: Emily – draft quote & press note (30m). Tom – confirm test conditions + permission to use graph (30m). Raj – social copy + screenshot (1h). Legal – @legal please advise. Jared — quick quote approval?
jared_ceo: Happy to provide: "Proud to see our investments in runtime optimizations deliver real-world latency improvements for customers." Approve for social/press.
emily_pr: Drafting now. Proposed tweet: `Benchmark Labs: Redwood Inference achieves ~2x lower p95 latency on 512-token generation vs competitorX. Proud to power fast experiences for engineers. Read: https://blog.redwood.example/bench` Will add screenshot.
tom_ops: Infra confirms tests used hosted model v1.3 with batching disabled — numbers reproduced. Permission to screenshot public graph depends on license; pinging legal.
legal: You can reuse a screenshot of the public report. Please avoid absolute language like "best" or "fastest" — use "lower latency observed" or similar.
asha: Great — Emily/Raj/Tom please confirm by 14:30. I'll run the distribution checklist and we can push once legal ok. :rocket:
